title: The Exorcist
short: Six films, two versions of one prequel
blurb: The original, two sequels, a prequel filmed twice by two different directors, and a 2023 follow-up that ignores most of it.
note: Exorcist: The Beginning and Dominion are two versions of the same prequel — the studio rejected the first cut, reshot it, then released both. You only need one. Believer is a sequel to the 1973 film and ignores the rest.
